tests.reason: Untestable (no way): Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS has no OSC 633 parser and drops the sequence silently without a target-state reading or log. The Mac app parses OSC in the shared core, not in its own frontend. Read tag v1.4.0 (ghostty-xpli4r8n1mqrzhbgxmkj4jfbpsjsqm3m-derived-source-tar, SHA256 d692bb9b), the source of the bundle version 1.4.0 the hosted run records: src/termio/Termio.zig:14,66 drives terminal.Stream with the one StreamHandler every app runtime uses, and src/terminal/osc.zig and stream.zig carry no OS branch. src/terminal/osc.zig:455-505 lists 133 and no 633; state .@"6" at :972-975 sends 3 to unknownOrInvalid at :748-753 (unknown_max_bytes=0 at :496), so end() at :1092-1103 returns null and logs nothing. The embedded runtime behind the Swift app (src/apprt/embedded.zig) has no OSC 633 path, and macos/Sources names OSC only for the OSC 8 and OSC 52 actions the core raises (Ghostty.App.swift:813-888, BaseTerminalController.swift:1622).

Read tag v1.4.0 (ghostty-xpli4r8n1mqrzhbgxmkj4jfbpsjsqm3m-derived-source-tar, SHA256 d692bb9b), the source of the bundle version 1.4.0 the hosted run records: src/termio/Termio.zig:14,66 drives terminal.Stream with the one StreamHandler every app runtime uses, and src/terminal/osc.zig and stream.zig carry no OS branch. src/terminal/osc.zig:455-505 lists 133 and no 633; state .@"6" at :972-975 sends 3 to unknownOrInvalid at :748-753 (unknown_max_bytes=0 at :496), so end() at :1092-1103 returns null and logs nothing. The embedded runtime behind the Swift app (src/apprt/embedded.zig) has no OSC 633 path, and macos/Sources names OSC only for the OSC 8 and OSC 52 actions the core raises (Ghostty.App.swift:813-888, BaseTerminalController.swift:1622).

tests.reason: Untestable (no way): Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS parses OSC 133 A/B/C/P into core row state that no public macOS surface reads back. The Mac surfaces carry no mark. Running jump_to_prompt through perform action and reading the visible text back is scraping UI state, not a non-intrusive prompt-mark reader.

tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): at shipped defaults Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS raises nothing a run can read when OSC 133;D arrives, so the cell is undecidable without a user config change. Traced in tag v1.4.0 (SHA256 d692bb9b): src/terminal/osc.zig:1180 parses 133, the exit code is an option of that parser (src/terminal/osc/parsers/semantic_prompt.zig:77-111), src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:918-965 passes it to the effect callback, src/termio/stream_handler.zig:1475-1508 turns end_command into stop_command at :1493, and src/Surface.zig:1198-1225 emits command_finished with the exit code and the measured duration. The Mac app returns immediately on the shipped default: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:1642-1712 reads notifyOnCommandFinish and returns when it is never (src/config/Config.zig:1214), the action defaults to bell without notify (:1228) behind a five-second floor (:1265), and only a user setting that gate reaches the bell or a UNUserNotificationCenter banner (:1599,:1620) outside the text cells and window screenshot the run measures. The D mark and the A/B/C cycle are stored as row content, visible only to the debug inspector (src/inspector/widgets/page.zig:291 via src/input/Binding.zig:688-691) and the snapshot serializer (src/terminal/snapshot/grid.zig:259), neither of which is a default-launch reader.

tests.reason: Untestable (no way): Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS stores OSC 8 hyperlinks in core page state and no Mac surface reads a URI back. Read tag v1.4.0 (SHA256 d692bb9b, the source of the bundle version the hosted run records): src/terminal/osc.zig:447,1160 and src/terminal/osc/parsers/hyperlink.zig parse and store the link in page.hyperlink_set (src/terminal/Screen.zig:2199,2222), read internally only by Surface.osc8URI (src/Surface.zig:4603-4613) for the hover and open-url paths. The one Mac consumer is the click action, macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:808 openURL routing the osc8 kind to openUntrustedURL (:860-883), and hover only sets dirty.hyperlink_hover (src/Surface.zig:1717). There is no readback: src/apprt/embedded.zig and macos/Sources contain zero occurrences of hyperlink, so no C API, Swift API, AppleScript property (macos/Ghostty.sdef:89-100) or Shortcuts intent (macos/Sources/Features/App Intents/GetTerminalDetailsIntent.swift:35-47) returns a URI, and hyperlink-emitting serialization is reached only from the snapshot serializers (src/terminal/snapshot/grid.zig:405,412, src/terminal/snapshot/screen.zig:2526, src/terminal/snapshot/page.zig:1140,1145,1242) which have no CLI state-dump verb. The instrument's link-metadata read has no macOS provider, and its plain term fallback cannot stand in: it writes the link, reads the cursor, and always returns probe-todo because cursor movement cannot verify OSC 8 link metadata or click behaviour (packages/probe-defs/src/extensions.ts:7395-7402).

tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): at shipped defaults Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS raises nothing a run can read when OSC 133;D arrives, so the cell is undecidable without a user config change. Traced in tag v1.4.0 (SHA256 d692bb9b): src/terminal/osc.zig:1180 parses 133, the exit code is an option of that parser (src/terminal/osc/parsers/semantic_prompt.zig:77-111), src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:918-965 passes it to the effect callback, src/termio/stream_handler.zig:1475-1508 turns end_command into stop_command at :1493, and src/Surface.zig:1198-1225 emits command_finished with the exit code and the measured duration. The Mac app returns immediately on the shipped default: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:1642-1712 reads notifyOnCommandFinish and returns when it is never (src/config/Config.zig:1214), the action defaults to bell without notify (:1228) behind a five-second floor (:1265), and only a user setting that gate reaches the bell or a UNUserNotificationCenter banner (:1599,:1620) outside the text cells and window screenshot the run measures. The D mark and the A/B/C cycle are stored as row content, visible only to the debug inspector (src/inspector/widgets/page.zig:291 via src/input/Binding.zig:688-691) and the snapshot serializer (src/terminal/snapshot/grid.zig:259), neither of which is a default-launch reader.
